L100000401757.text: The possible-updates sheet says Lotus Infrastructure Partners agreed to buy the Caithness Long Island Energy Center, reported on November 20, 2025. Has the sale closed? If a document dated after closing names the new plant-holding entity, report Owner(s) with that document and a second independent publisher. If the sale is only announced or pending, leave Owner(s) alone and put what you found in a question.

L100000401765.text: Constellation Energy bought Calpine. GEM already lists the parent as Constellation Energy Corp and the owner as Calpine Eastern Corp. Check whether the company that holds this plant has been renamed or merged into another entity in a dated document. Only report a new Owner(s) if a document names the new plant-holding entity; the parent changing is not an owner change. Otherwise say in a question what you found.

L100000401662.text: The possible-updates sheet says Digi Power X plans a data center at this plant and a 60 MW expansion. Check three things. First, does the plant now mainly serve a data center on site? If a source says so, report Captive non-industry use (values: heat, power, both) and Captive industry type as data center, with the source; if it still sells to the grid, leave the captive fields blank. Second, is the 60 MW expansion a real new unit with a status (announced, pre-construction, construction)? If so list it under newunits with its status, capacity and sources; if it is only talk, add a monitor item with a recheck date. Third, confirm the owner GEM lists, Digi Power X Inc, with a dated document.

L100000104067.text: Other Name(s) says Roseton Generating Station. Roseton is the neighboring plant, with its own EIA plant code. Check whether this alias is wrong and raise a question with what you find; do not change any value for this.

The combined cycle unit is cancelled. The Department of Environmental Conservation denied its Title V air permit in October 2021 and the owner appealed. Find the date the project was finally dropped or the appeal lost, and record it as Cancellation year with Latest Activity.

L100000406975.text: The Department of Environmental Conservation denied the Title V air permit for this repowering in October 2021 and NRG appealed; GEM's Latest Activity is dated January 24, 2024. Find how the appeal ended and the date, and record it as Cancellation year with Latest Activity.
